fields.meta_title: Fantasy Football Sign Up Sheet With a Team Cap | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a fantasy football sign up sheet with a team cap and a draft-night poll, saved to a database you own. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Fantasy Football Sign-Up Sheet for the Whole Preseason
fields.hero_description: Build a fantasy football sign up sheet that caps your league at a set number of teams and polls managers on draft night.
fields.features_heading: What the Commissioner Needs Before Draft Night
fields.features_subheading: A fantasy football sign up sheet records who is in. Emergent builds one that also keeps a waitlist and runs the draft-night poll.
fields.feature_1:
A team cap with a waitlist behind it

Set the league at 10, 12 or 14 teams. The sheet closes at that number, and each later sign-up joins a waitlist in the order it arrived, ready for the first manager who drops.
fields.feature_2:
The email the league invite goes to

Ask each manager for a team name and the email address the league app will invite. A typo caught on the sheet beats resending invites the week of the draft, when nobody reads email.
fields.feature_3:
Keeper picks held to your league's limit

Returning managers name their keepers and the round each one costs. The form accepts no more than the limit you set, so a third keeper in a two-keeper league never reaches the list.
fields.feature_4:
A draft-night poll with a running count

List the nights and times you can host the draft, and each manager marks every one that works. The dashboard counts yes votes per night, so the commissioner picks with numbers.
fields.feature_5:
Reminders for managers who go quiet

Set a deadline for sign-ups or keepers. Anyone who has not answered two days before it gets an email reminder, and the commissioner sees the names still missing on one screen.
fields.feature_6:
Your league's code, on your GitHub

On paid plans, export the full codebase to your GitHub repository and host the sheet wherever you like. Next season, change it with a new prompt or edit the code yourself.

fields.tab_content_1:
Into the waitlist goes team 13

Dunhollow Logistics fills its office league at 12 teams, the cap commissioner Mireya Gunnarsen set on the sheet. A dispatcher signs up thirteenth with a team called Pallet Jacks and goes first on the waitlist. Mireya sees all 13 sign-ups on her dashboard. If a manager drops before the draft, Pallet Jacks gets the seat.
fields.tab_content_2:
Keeper picks from all but one manager

Keepers come due 7 days before the draft in the Tullamore Road keeper league, where 10 managers return. Each one names up to 2 players to keep. Nine lists are in 2 days before the deadline. Desh Kavanagh gets an email reminder, and his team shows on the commissioner's missing list.
fields.tab_content_3:
Draft on Thursday at 8 pm, which suits 11 of 14

The Amberleigh Taproom league has 14 managers, and organizer Renzo Haskard put three draft nights on the sign-up sheet. Each manager checks every night that works. Thursday at 8 pm gets 11 yes votes, Friday at 7 pm gets 8 and Sunday at 1 pm gets 6. Renzo emails the league that the draft is Thursday at 8 pm.
fields.tab_content_4:
By 5 votes to 3, the family picks PPR

The family league has 8 Brumfields, and its sheet asks each one to vote on scoring. A PPR league gives a player a point for every catch, and a standard league gives none. PPR wins 5 votes to 3. Commissioner Bea Brumfield sees the count on her dashboard and sets the league to PPR before the invites go out.

faq_plan.q: What is a fantasy football sign up sheet?
How do I create a fantasy football sign up sheet?

plan.angle: The top 10 for fantasy football sign up sheet is template pages (survey and form builders, printable sheets on Pinterest) and the big platforms' league-creation screens. Those collect a name and a team name. This page shows the sheet as the commissioner's preseason desk: a team cap with a waitlist for an office league, keeper picks collected before a deadline, a draft-night poll that settles the date, and a scoring vote that sets PPR or standard before anyone opens the league app. The how-to and FAQ cover what templates skip: league size, the invite email field, deadlines tied to draft night, and keeping the sheet's answers in one table.
tab_stories: Dunhollow Logistics caps its office league at 12 teams, and the 13th manager to sign up lands first on a waitlist that commissioner Mireya Gunnarsen sees on her dashboard.
The Tullamore Road keeper league asks its 10 returning managers for up to 2 keepers each a week before the draft, and the 1 manager who has not answered gets a reminder email.
Amberleigh Taproom's 14 managers each mark the draft nights they can make, and Thursday at 8 pm wins with 11 of 14 while organizer Renzo Haskard reads the tally.
The Brumfield family league puts scoring to a vote on its sign-up sheet, and PPR takes 5 of 8 votes before the commissioner sets up the league.
